content.text: The text report now hoists a branch's checkpoint intent to its header when every conflict on that side quotes the same checkpoint, keeps per-conflict "why" lines only when the checkpoints differ, and wraps quoted intents at 88 columns, while JSON output is unchanged. The first live rehearsal, two headless Claude Code agents in two worktrees finishing in 51 seconds, produced a correct report whose two findings each repeated both agents' full prompts, so a judge with eight minutes met the same 600 characters four times before reaching the explanation. Running `entire checkpoint explain --generate <id>` after each agent commits writes an AI summary into the checkpoint in about ten seconds, so MergeRadar quotes that summarised intent, labelled "from summary", instead of the raw prompt. The open item is that this mirror clone stores checkpoints on the shared entire/checkpoints/v1 branch rather than as per-checkpoint refs, and the intent reader only understands the refs layout, so it reports intents as "missing" here.
